public_rationale: The March 3, 2025 passage says revenue does not appear 'meaningful' while acknowledging reported AI revenue and comparing it with investment [wyea-power-cut-f8e21e-o1]. Microsoft reported an AI-business annual revenue run rate above $13 billion on January 29, 2025; this was an annualized measure, not realized full-year revenue [e1]. The passage supplies no threshold for 'meaningful,' defined sector boundary or matched comparison period, so a factual verdict would require adding a measurement standard [wyea-power-cut-f8e21e-o1].
limitations: Microsoft's disclosure does not establish sector-wide generative-AI revenue or investment returns [e1].
The passage compares an annualized revenue figure with capital expenditure accumulated since 2023, without matching the periods [wyea-power-cut-f8e21e-o1; e1].
The disclosed revenue figure cannot supply the missing standard for whether revenue is meaningful [e1; wyea-power-cut-f8e21e-o1].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI does not appear to generate meaningful revenue.

statement.excerpt: Worse still, there doesn’t appear to be meaningful revenue.

from_speaker: on over $200 billion of capital expenditures since 2023
our_interpretation: The surrounding passage explicitly acknowledges substantial reported AI revenue and compares it with investment. It cannot fairly be read as saying that revenue is zero.
Meaningful could refer to absolute scale, investment returns, revenue relative to expenditure or the extent of public disclosure. The speaker supplies no threshold or consistent comparison period.
For contextual financial evidence, the reference period is October–December 2024, the latest completed quarter publicly reportable before the post.
The hedge and undefined threshold prevent a single ordinary factual test without adding a material standard.
criteria.support_condition: No determinate condition can be specified without adding a revenue threshold, sector boundary and comparison basis that the speaker did not supply.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No determinate condition can be specified fairly. The existence of substantial revenue alone does not contradict an expressly acknowledged but allegedly inadequate revenue level.
